body:
## Intake review

**Related:** linked from the issue body and title where applicable; see notes. No merged PR was found that explicitly resolves this issue (checked the 300 most recent merged PRs for a fixes/closes/resolves reference) — it is still live.

**Notes:** Follow-up slice of issue #5755 (slice 1); design context in issue #5669. This is a decision-first slice: the implementation fork (push label filters into the scan via content-store ids vs stay on the monolith) changes the work materially, so the decision should be recorded here before code.

**Risks:** Filters resolved via the content store add a cross-store join to the scan path; staying on the monolith defers the problem to cutover, when shard volume may make it urgent.

**Suggested approach:** Prototype the content-store id pushdown against one hosted shard, measure, then decide; record the decision and split any build work into its own slice.

Labels normalized at intake: kind/enhancement, status/needs-triage, priority/normal, effort/m, app/atlas-search; effort class per the fleet taxonomy. Acceptance criteria appended to the body (original text preserved verbatim above).

— fleet monitor, intake pass 2026-11-07
